instruction: Find arXiv papers about 'PaLM' language models published in September 2023 and add at least one complete entry to the spreadsheet, ensuring all three columns (title, arXiv link, date) are filled.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding PaLM-related papers with complete information in all three columns. The evaluator retrieves all data rows and verifies that at least one row meets all requirements: (1) title contains 'PaLM' (case-insensitive), (2) link is from arXiv (contains 'arxiv.org'), (3) date is in September 2023 (various formats accepted), and (4) all three columns are filled. Returns 1.0 if at least one valid row exists.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete semantic verification: The evaluator correctly verifies all four instruction requirements.
Requirement 1 (PaLM topic): Metric checks title contains 'palm' (case-insensitive regex) at line 31.
Requirement 2 (arXiv source): Metric checks link contains 'arxiv.org' at line 35.
Requirement 3 (September 2023 date): Metric checks date matches September 2023 patterns (lines 41-48), supporting multiple formats like '2023-09', 'Sep 2023', 'September 2023', '09/2023', etc.
Requirement 4 (completeness): Metric checks all three columns are filled with non-None, non-empty values at lines 25-26.
Correct logic flow: Getter extracts all spreadsheet rows (excluding header), metric iterates through rows and returns 1.0 if at least one row meets all requirements.
Proper postconfig: Activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) before reading, ensuring fresh state.
Robust implementation: Handles edge cases like empty data, partial rows, and various date formats.
